column1: # Copied from otfabric/iec60870-5-interop tests/iec101/cases.tsv at v0.5.0 (contract 2.3).
# Refresh it with the harness version pinned in harness.go.
# Self-test cases of IEC 60870-5-101 for scripts/interop.sh, against the
# baseline fixture (fixtures/iec101/baseline), run once per link mode
# (LINK_MODE=unbalanced and LINK_MODE=balanced). The cases of IEC 104 without
# the ones IEC 101 does not have: file transfer (not in the baseline), the
# CP56Time2a command types 58..64 and C_TS_TA_1 (IEC 101 tests with C_TS_NA_1).
# The broadcast common address of a one-octet field is 255.
#   1  id      stable dotted scenario id of results.json (prefixed with
#   2  state   "ro" (the case does not change the station; servers are shared)
#              "rw" (the case gets a freshly started server)
#   3  exit    expected exit code of the client
#   4  summary expected outcome: ok, error code, confirmations (cause, "n" when
#              negative), termination, and type/cause of every received ASDU
#   5  needs   "-", or features the pairing must declare in print-capabilities,
#   6  operation and its flags, as passed to "client"
# Every case runs for every client/server pairing. Besides matching the
# expectation, all pairings must produce the same result document.
# Field sizes (contract 2.3): the link flags of an operation (--link-address,
# case's server as well, since both ends of a line are configured alike; a "ro"
# case shares one server per adapter and set of link flags. A pairing runs such
# a case only when both images list every size of it in linkAddressSizes,
# cotSizes, caSizes and ioaSizes, and a link address size of 0 only in balanced
# mode; otherwise the pairing is skipped as unsupported. In unbalanced mode a
# client without the feature unbalancedCommonAddress is skipped for a case
# whose request carries a common address other than the link address (connect
# and monitor send none). The ids of these cases are case.fields-<link address
